title: Chemical Reactions and Equations: Chapter Introduction
subject: Chemistry
objective: A burning magnesium ribbon leaves only white powder: the same atoms in a new arrangement. How to spot a reaction, write and balance its equation, and name its type.

fill.q: When magnesium burns in air, it forms ____.
A substance that forms in a reaction is called a ____.
An insoluble solid formed in a reaction is a ____.
A balanced equation obeys the law of conservation of ____.
Rusting of iron is an example of ____.

tf.q: In a chemical reaction new substances are formed.
tf.explain: The atoms rearrange into new substances.
O: 2 on the left, 1 on the right; balanced form is 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO.

tf.q: Chips packets are filled with oxygen to keep chips fresh.
tf.explain: They are flushed with nitrogen to prevent rancidity.

tf.q: A change of colour can show that a reaction has occurred.
tf.explain: It is one of the signs of a chemical reaction.

ar.a: A balanced equation has equal atoms of each element on both sides.
ar.r: Mass is neither created nor destroyed in a reaction.
Paint keeps air and moisture away and prevents rusting.

mcq.q: The white powder left after burning magnesium is:

short.q: List four observations that show a chemical reaction has taken place.
short.solution: Evolution of a gas, change in colour, change in temperature, formation of a precipitate (also change in state).

match.explain: Each pattern matches its reaction type.
